jak3-better-forms.name: Jak 3 Better Forms Mod
jak3-better-forms.desc: Dark Jak and Light Jak never auto-de-transform. Dark Jak can use all weapons (directional buttons to equip, R1 to shoot or attack). Jetboard usable in both forms. Crouch and rolls work in both forms. DragonBall-style 4x speed and jump multipliers.
